tagline.en: A 1.3B Wan2.1-Fun control model that animates an image along a camera path you specify.
tagline.zh: 一个 1.3B 的 Wan2.1-Fun 控制模型，沿你指定的相机轨迹让图片动起来。

en: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 1.3B Control Camera is a camera-controlled image-to-video model from Alibaba PAI's VideoX-Fun project. Give it a starting image and a camera trajectory, and it generates a clip that moves the camera through the scene along that path.

It is the lightweight 1.3B member of the Wan2.1-Fun control family, built on the Wan2.1 architecture with a camera-conditioned control branch. The pose-conditioned route renders the video with just a few denoising steps, producing coherent camera-motion clips at 672×384.
In WorldFoundry you run it through its pipeline — provide the image and camera control, and it writes out the resulting video.
zh: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 1.3B Control Camera 是阿里巴巴 PAI 的 VideoX-Fun 项目推出的相机可控图生视频模型。给它一张起始图片与一条相机轨迹，它便生成一段沿该轨迹在场景中运镜的片段。
它是 Wan2.1-Fun 控制家族中的轻量 1.3B 成员，构建在 Wan2.1 架构之上，带有相机条件化的控制分支。姿态条件化路径只需少数几个去噪步即可渲染视频，产出 672×384 的连贯运镜片段。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过它的 pipeline 运行——提供图片与相机控制，它便输出生成的视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to animate a still image with controlled camera motion on modest hardware — a lightweight 1.3B option for pose-conditioned camera moves.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想在普通硬件上以可控运镜让静态图片动起来时使用——一个用于姿态条件化运镜的轻量 1.3B 选择。

notFor.en: It generates short camera-motion clips rather than long or narrative video. The camera checkpoint and its Wan components must be staged locally before use.
notFor.zh: 它生成的是短促的运镜片段，而非长片或叙事视频。相机 checkpoint 及其 Wan 组件需先放到本地再使用。

en: Camera-controlled image-to-video from Alibaba PAI's VideoX-Fun
Lightweight 1.3B model on the Wan2.1 architecture
Pose-conditioned camera motion in just a few denoising steps
zh: 来自阿里巴巴 PAI VideoX-Fun 的相机可控图生视频
基于 Wan2.1 架构的轻量 1.3B 模型
仅需少数几个去噪步的姿态条件化运镜
